title: Logistic regression
learner_goal: Understand how logistic regression turns inputs into a probability, how it decides a class, and how it is trained.
opening_message: I want to learn logistic regression.
simulator_misconceptions: the model outputs a class label directly rather than a probability
the sigmoid output is the same kind of number a linear regression predicts
it is trained by minimizing squared error, like linear regression
a coefficient is the change in probability per unit of its input
the decision threshold must always be 0.5
